The user asks: "在 temp 目錄內，您能否直接在終端中列出所有當前文件，包括所有隱藏文件，確保我們保持當前目錄結構不變，並避免生成任何額外的目錄或文件？"

We need to list all files in temp directory, including hidden files. We should not change directory structure or create new directories/files. We just need to list. We can use ls with -a. The tool is ls. We need to specify a=True. Also we need to ensure we are in temp directory. We might need to cd to temp first. But the user says "在 temp 目錄內" meaning "in the temp directory". So we should cd to temp then ls -a. But we must not create any new directories or files. So just cd and ls. We can do cd to temp. Then ls with a=True. That will list all files. We should not create anything. So we call cd with folder="temp". Then ls with a=True. Let's do that.
